diff_rules.message: C# 9+ `is not` is forbidden in `Cavern/` and `Cavern.Format/` (target netstandard2.1 / C# 8.0).
File-scoped namespace is C# 10+ and forbidden in `Cavern/` and `Cavern.Format/` (C# 8.0).
Target-typed `new()` is C# 9+ and forbidden in `Cavern/` and `Cavern.Format/` (netstandard2.1 / C# 8.0).
Horizontal LinearLayout near buttons/pills without visible `BaselineAligned = false` in local window.
W^X violation: executing or dlopen-ing binaries from FilesDir/bin is forbidden; resolve bundled .so from ApplicationInfo.NativeLibraryDir.
Deprecated SystemUI/Window bar color API detected; use WindowInsets / WindowInsetsController Edge-to-Edge APIs.
requestLegacyExternalStorage is forbidden on targetSdkVersion >= 35; use MediaStore/SAF Scoped Storage.

Prefer `OperatingSystem.IsAndroidVersionAtLeast(N)` over `Build.VERSION.SdkInt` comparisons so Roslyn CA1416/CA1422 platform analyzers recognize the OS guard (and repeat the guard inside lambdas/callbacks).
Qualify `System.Diagnostics.Process.Start(...)` in Android files to prevent CS0104 ambiguity when `Android.OS` is imported (BL-004).
Custom numeric format `:0.1`/`:0.2` emits literal digits in C#; use `:0.0`/`:0.00` or `:F1`/`:F2` (BL-009).
`.NET Android` `TextView`/`Button` exposes `SetAllCaps(bool)` method, not an `AllCaps` property (BL-005).
Unescaped `&` in XML documentation comment triggers CS1570; escape as `&` (BL-008).
RT-audio guard: heap allocation (`malloc`/`calloc`/`realloc`) detected in `Native/cavernize_proaudio/`; pre-allocate buffers at init and keep RT AAudio/USB callbacks 0-alloc & lock-free.
RT-audio guard: logging/console I/O detected in `Cavern/VocalChain/`; keep real-time vocal DSP strictly zero-GC, lock-free, and telemetry-via-snapshot only.

media-native.module_title: Native Decoders, Pro-Audio, Services & Android Platform
media-native.lens: Android NDK/Audio Systems Engineer (W^X NativeLibraryDir pre/post W23, 16KB ELF, API 35/36 compliance, lock-free AAudio/libusb)
checklist: Enforce `android:targetSdkVersion` >= 35 (35/36), `extractNativeLibs="true"`, `enableOnBackInvokedCallback="true"`, W^X `NativeLibraryDir` execution (zero `FilesDir/bin/` exec), 16 KB ELF alignment, and API 33+ runtime/FGS compliance.
Check `SafePipeHandle` / stream disposal, lock-free audio/USB lifecycles, bitmap `.Recycle()` safety, and `AppLogger` error diagnostics.

Zero-Warning Live Check: inspect `fetch_live_diagnostics.py --ci` & current official Android/.NET docs before touching OS-versioned APIs; use `OperatingSystem.IsAndroidVersionAtLeast(N)` in the exact scope (incl. inside lambdas) or `[SupportedOSPlatform]` (see `PROJECT_HISTORY.md` Sec 2).
